# SCEA SCERT"): objects from each file's static rcsid ("$Header: /projects/rtime/CVS/<path>,v")
# and their local symbols; global functions by name prefix.  Link order sorts the files of each
# library by name, so the files without an rcsid get names that sort in place: LargeInt.c (its
# assert path), md5.c, rt_constraint.c, rt_lan_message.c (guessed).  RC4_asm/md5_asm: hand asm
